mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, u.age AS user_age, u.email AS user_email, o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.amount, o.status AS order_status FROM user u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, u.age AS user_age, u.email AS user_email, o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.amount, o.status AS order_status FROM user u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id ORDER BY u.id, o.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, u.age AS user_age, u.email AS user_email, o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.amount, o.status AS order_status FROM user u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, u.age AS user_age, u.email AS user_email, o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.amount, o.status AS order_status FROM orders o INNER JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, u.age AS user_age, u.email AS user_email, COUNT(o.id) AS order_id, SUM(o.amount) AS amount FROM user u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.phone, u.age, u.email ORDER BY u.id
